row: 30006465 / OWR-14299577-018: Differences of signed representatives; Bernert–Arala Santos questions (OWR51/2025, p.2756)

Differences of Signed Representatives: Sharp Answers to Two Questions of Bernert and Arala Santos — Alper Ferudun (Mercury Software GmbH), v1.0, 2026-09-28. Existing external publication; credit is Ferudun, not Alec Kriebel authorship or a new publication from this sweep. For every set A with exactly one of ±k for 1<=k<=n, at most two positive differences in [1,n] are missing. For every B subset of [1,n], including empty B, the ordered-pair count is >=floor((|B|-1)^2/4), giving the positive-density quadratic bound asymptotically. Coverage is sharp for n>=2; pair-bound attainment is proved for 1<=|B|<=floor(2n/3)+1. Necessity of that cutoff and ancillary characterization/uniqueness remarks remain unproved; no all-small-n positive quadratic bound claimed.
